summary: Retested iteration_40's HIGH bug on mi-build-button (Pass-2 last question) and the new backend content-leakage critic. BOTH TARGETED FIXES VERIFIED. The Pass-2 last-question 'Build my ideas' button now enables from typed text alone (allPass2Answered now counts local `answer` for the current index when in Pass 2), and clicking it advances into mi-construct -> mi-construct-save -> mi-done -> ot-continue-button which advances to 'My Current Answer' end-to-end. The Pass-1 definition coach message on 'What is a fixed mindset?' answered with a behavior ('It is when someone stops trying when work is hard.') names DEFINITION structure and points the student back to their own answer/source WITHOUT supplying or cueing the actual definition (no mention of ability, intelligence, beliefs, effort, static/growth, etc.). Full My Ideas two-pass flow (assignment -> questions -> my_ideas -> pass1 -> knowledge_map -> confirm_map -> make_plan -> inquiry_plan -> pause -> paused -> resume -> pass2 -> build -> construct -> construct_save -> done -> ot-continue -> my_current_answer) completes green.
verbatim_coach_message_pass1_definition: This question asks for a definition. A definition tells what something IS and names the core feature that makes it that kind of thing. Your sentence describes what a person might do, but it doesn't say what the mindset itself is. Does your answer tell what a fixed mindset IS, or only what happens because of it? Revise it to state what the mindset itself is. Check your notes or source for the defining idea, then say it in your own words.

leakage_check.notes: Message names 'definition' as the missing structural move, uses generic placeholder 'the defining idea', and explicitly redirects the student to 'your notes or source' + 'your own words'. Does NOT mention ability, intelligence, belief, static, growth, effort, talent, or any subject-matter cue. Passes leakage guard.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 40's single HIGH bug (mi-build-button on Pass-2 last question) is CONFIRMED FIXED. Sequence used: preview=ot -> Begin -> assignment 'Write about fixed vs growth mindset in school.' -> ot-stage-questions -> ot-object-input with 'What is a fixed mindset?\nHow does growth mindset help students improve?' -> ot-stage-my_ideas (questions autosave on stage change) -> Pass1 Q1 answer -> next -> Pass1 Q2 answer -> to_map -> confirm rows (mi-map-status-i-*) -> confirm-map -> make-plan -> pause -> resume -> Pass2 Q1 answer -> next (waits ~30-60s for Sonnet critic) -> Pass2 Q2 answer typed only (no share) -> mi-build-button IS ENABLED -> build -> construct-input (>=10) -> construct-save -> done -> ot-continue-button enabled -> advances to 'My Current Answer'. rca of the issue: Iteration 40 RCA: allPass2Answered read persisted pass2_text only; last Pass-2 question has no Next button so freshly-typed text never landed in ideas.responses[last].pass2_text and Build stayed disabled. Fix (verified in this run at MyIdeasWorkflow.jsx L233-239): for the current index during Pass 2, allPass2Answered counts (persisted || answer.trim()), which mirrors toConstruct's persistIfDirty contract. Reproduced happy path end-to-end; typing on the last question is now sufficient to unblock Build.
